question: __________ is commonly represented by the Greek letter ρ (rho).
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Electrical resistivity.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Electrical resistivity is a **measure of how strongly a material opposes the flow of electric current through it.**
 
• It is defined as: **ρ=R(A/L)**
 
 
• where:
 
• ρ = electrical resistivity,
 
• R = electrical resistance,
 
• A = cross-sectional area of the conductor,
 
• L = length of the conductor
 
 
 
• **Material Property**: Higher resistivity means greater opposition to current flow.
 
• **Temperature Effect**: Resistivity typically increases with temperature for most conductors, affecting the performance of electrical components.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Concept
 Definition
 
 
 
 

 **Current Flow**
 The rate at which electric charge flows through a conductor. Measured in **amperes** (A).
 
 

 **Charge**
 The fundamental property of matter that causes it to experience a force in an electric field. Measured in **coulombs** (C).
 
 

 **Electrical Conductivity**
 A measure of a material's ability to conduct electric current. The reciprocal of resistivity. Measured in **siemens per meter **(S/m).
